picks.question: Will there be no change in Fed interest rates after the October 2026 meeting?
picks.why: Whether the Fed holds steady in October signals how policymakers are weighing sticky inflation against a cooling labor market.

picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: A large share of the world's seaborne oil passes through Hormuz, so prolonged disruption keeps energy prices and inflation risks elevated.

picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A state-level wealth tax would test the revenue potential and capital-flight concerns that dominate debates over taxing top fortunes.

picks.question: Will OpenAI not IPO by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: The timing of an OpenAI listing would show how public markets price frontier AI and shape capital flows into the sector.

picks.question: Will Anthropic have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Which lab holds the frontier shows how competitive AI development is, which matters for productivity gains, pricing power, and regulation.

picks.question: Will OpenAI announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: AI solving a famous unsolved math problem would signal a leap in machine reasoning with broad implications for research productivity.
